## Summary

Describe the change and why it belongs in `chatgpt-system`.

## Verification

- [ ] `npm run check`
- [ ] macOS-native changes were built/tested on macOS when applicable
- [ ] `git diff --check`

## Security impact

- [ ] No secrets, leases, credentials, tokens, biometric material, raw PIDs, or sensitive command output were added to source, logs, fixtures, or documentation
- [ ] Authority boundaries are unchanged, or the change explains and tests the intended boundary change
- [ ] New process execution remains structured and does not introduce shell-string execution

## Scope

- [ ] The change is focused and does not bundle unrelated refactors
- [ ] Documentation was updated when behavior or operator workflow changed
